AgentConfigDefinitionGitCredentials.description: Integration whose git credentials the agent's machines use.

integration.description: Name of a project GitHub integration whose installation supplies the credentials. Resolved to the integration's immutable ID when the config is compiled.

read_only.description: Prevents pushing and opening or approving pull requests, even if the integration allows it.

repository_ids.description: GitHub repository IDs the credentials can access. Defaults to every repository the installation can access.

AgentConfigDefinitionInteractionHandler.description: Enables an integration's interaction handler. Takes no settings.

AgentConfigDefinitionInteractionHandlers.description: Interaction handlers keyed by integration name.

region.description: AWS signing region of the MCP endpoint. Required for sigv4 and rejected for other types. It does not limit which AWS regions tool calls can target.

secret_id.description: Secret holding the credential. Its kind must match type: a generic secret for bearer, oauth_token_set for oauth, or aws_credentials for sigv4. The config never contains the credential itself.

service.description: AWS SigV4 signing service name, such as aws-mcp. Required for sigv4 and rejected for other types.

type.description: How requests are authenticated: bearer sends a static token, oauth uses tokens from Omnara's MCP OAuth flow, and sigv4 signs each request with AWS Signature Version 4.

auth.description: How Omnara authenticates to this server. Omit it for servers that need no authentication.

default_enabled.description: Whether the server's tools are exposed unless overridden per tool. Defaults to true. Set it to false to expose only the tools marked enabled: true under tools.

deferred.description: When true, the server's tools stay out of the model's context until tool_search loads them. A tool's own deferred setting overrides this. Defaults to false.

permission.description: Default permission for this server's tools. A tool's own permission overrides it. Defaults to always_ask.

tools.description: Per-tool overrides, keyed by the tool's name on the MCP server (without the mcp__{server}__ prefix).

url.description: The server's MCP endpoint. Must use https. Plain http is accepted only for loopback hosts on deployments that enable insecure local development.

deferred.description: Overrides the server's deferred setting for this tool. Null or omitted inherits the server's value.

enabled.description: true exposes this tool and false hides it. Null or omitted follows the server's default_enabled.

permission.description: Permission for calls to this tool. Overrides the server's permission.

cwd.description: Working directory for the agent's processes on this source's machines. Replaces the machine's or pool's default.

delete_after_idle_minutes.description: Pool sources only. Deletes a pool machine after it has had no process work for this many minutes. Unset inherits the grant or pool setting, and 0 disables idle deletion.

description.description: Note describing this source to the agent, such as what the pool or machine is for. list_machines shows it with each pool.

env_overlay.description: Environment variables for every process the agent runs on these machines. For pools, they also apply at provisioning. Set a value to null to remove an inherited variable.

initial_num_machines.description: Pool sources only. Number of pool machines created when the agent launches. Defaults to 1 (0 when max_machines is 0) and cannot exceed max_machines.

machine_cpu.description: Pool sources only. Default CPU count for this agent's new pool machines, within pool and project limits. Support varies by provider.

machine_memory_mb.description: Pool sources only. Default memory in MB for this agent's new pool machines, within pool and project limits. Support varies by provider.

machine_name.description: Name of a BYO machine granted to the project. Set this or machine_pool_name, not both. Resolved to the machine's immutable ID at compile time.

machine_pool_name.description: Name of a machine pool granted to the project, from which Omnara creates machines on demand. Set this or machine_name, not both.

machine_provider_options_overlay.description: Pool sources only. Provider-specific machine options layered over the pool's and project grant's options for this agent's new machines.

max_machines.description: Pool sources only. Total pool machines this agent may hold from this source, including ones it creates with create_machine. Defaults to 1. Pool and project limits still apply.

secret_env_overlay.description: Environment variables whose values come from secrets (sec_... IDs), resolved when injected. Applies like env_overlay. Set a value to null to remove an inherited variable.

access.description: read lets the agent read the store's files. read_write also lets it write them, but only when the store's agent_access is also read_write.

name.description: Name of a memory store in the project. Its files appear to the agent at /memory/<name>/.

cache_retention.description: Prompt-cache preference: none sends no Omnara cache controls, short uses the route's default caching, and long prefers an extended cache lifetime where one exists. Unset uses the configured model's default.

context_window_tokens.description: Context budget for input and output tokens. Triggers compaction when estimated input exceeds the remaining budget after output and safety reserves. The turn fails if compaction cannot make it fit.

default_max_output_tokens.description: Per-request output-token cap sent to the provider. Overrides the configured model's default.

name.description: Configured model name. Must exactly match a model configured under provider_config that is available to the project.

provider_config.description: Name of the organization's model provider. Resolved to the provider's immutable ID when the config is created.

reasoning.description: Reasoning settings for models that support them. effort, such as low, medium or high, overrides the configured model's default reasoning effort.

archive_after_idle_minutes.description: Archives subagents spawned from this key after they have been idle this many minutes. When unset, they are not archived for being idle.

description.description: Shown to the model when it chooses which subagent key to spawn.

instruction.description: Changes to the launched config's instruction.

max_instances.description: Cap on active subagents spawned from this key. When unset, there is no per-key cap, but max_subagents still applies.

model.description: Model overrides for this subagent. Omit provider_config and name to inherit the parent's model (self) or the profile's model (profile). Other fields override that model individually.

profile.description: Name of the agent profile to launch from, using the profile's current config. Required when type is profile and rejected for self.

type.description: profile launches from the named profile's current config. self launches from a copy of this agent's own config.

append.description: Text appended after a blank line to the base config's instruction for subagents spawned from this key.

cache_retention.description: Overrides the base model's prompt-cache preference for this subagent: none, short or long. Unset keeps the base value.

context_window_tokens.description: Context budget for input and output tokens. Triggers compaction when estimated input exceeds the remaining budget after output and safety reserves. The turn fails if compaction cannot make it fit.

default_max_output_tokens.description: Overrides the base model's per-request output-token cap for this subagent. Unset keeps the base value.

name.description: Configured model name under provider_config. Set it together with provider_config to switch models, or omit both to keep the base model.

provider_config.description: Model provider name. Set it together with name to select a different model for this subagent, or omit both to inherit.

reasoning.description: Overrides the base model's reasoning effort for this subagent. Unset keeps the base setting.

deferred.description: When true, the tool's definition stays out of the model's context until tool_search loads it. Adds tool_search automatically, and tool_search itself cannot be deferred. Defaults to false.

description.description: Custom tools only. Tells the model what the tool does and when to use it. Required when type is custom and rejected for built-in tools.

enabled.description: Set to false to turn the tool off, including tools Omnara would otherwise add by default. Omitted or null enables it.

input_schema.description: Custom tools only. JSON Schema for the tool's arguments. Required when type is custom and rejected for built-in tools.

permission.description: Overrides the tool's default permission. Custom tools default to always_allow; built-in defaults and supported modes are listed in GET /tool-catalog.

type.description: built_in (the default) selects a tool Omnara runs, by its catalog name. custom declares a tool your system runs and answers through the tool-calls API.

AgentConfigDefinitionToolInputSchema.description: A JSON Schema for the tool's input. Keywords beyond those listed, such as additionalProperties or description, are allowed.

properties.description: The tool's arguments, keyed by argument name, each defined as a JSON Schema.

required.description: Names of arguments the model must supply. Each one must also be declared in properties.

type.description: Always object, because tool arguments are passed as a single JSON object.

mode.description: always_allow runs each call immediately, always_ask pauses it until a human approves or denies it, and always_deny refuses it. Supported modes per tool are in GET /tool-catalog.

parameters.description: Mode-specific settings, validated against the mode's parameters_schema in GET /tool-catalog. The current modes take none, so omit it or send {}.

MemoryStoreName.description: Machine-readable memory store identifier consisting of lowercase ASCII segments separated by single hyphens.

ResourceNameReference.description: Name of an existing resource, resolved when the config is compiled.

description: An agent config as a JSON object. This schema is the source of truth for agent configs: the server compiles YAML and JSON configs against it.

git_credentials.description: GitHub integration whose credentials authenticate HTTPS Git and gh in the agent's machine processes. Adds list_github_repositories. Subagents never receive these credentials.

instruction.description: System-level brief for the agent: its job, its boundaries, and when to ask a human. Subagents can add to it with instruction.append.

interaction_handlers.description: Integration interaction handlers the agent can use to present questions and approvals outside the dashboard, keyed by integration name with empty objects. Not inherited by subagents.

machine_sources.description: BYO machines and machine pools the agent runs commands on. A nonempty list adds the command, process and machine tools. A pool source also adds create_machine and delete_machine.

max_depth.description: How many levels of subagents can nest below this agent. Defaults to 1, so subagents cannot spawn their own. Carried into every subagent config and cannot be raised by a subagent.

max_subagents.description: Cap on active subagents across all subagents keys. When unset, the config sets no overall cap and only each key's max_instances applies.

mcp.description: MCP servers the agent connects to, keyed by a server name. The name appears in tool names as mcp__{server}__{tool}.

memory_stores.description: Project memory stores the agent can use at /memory/<store-name>/ through the file tools. Attaching a store adds the retrieval tools, and read_write access adds storage_write.

model.description: Model the agent runs on, selected by provider and configured model name, plus optional overrides of that model's defaults.

skills.description: IDs (skl_...) of skills the agent can load with the skill tool, which is added automatically. The project must own or be granted each skill, and skill names must be unique within the list.

subagents.description: Subagents this agent may spawn, keyed by the name it passes to spawn_agent. Declaring any key adds the five subagent tools.

tools.description: Built-in and custom tools keyed by tool name. {} enables a tool with its defaults. MCP tools are configured under mcp.

version.description: Config format version. Only v1 exists today. It is optional, but include it for forward compatibility.
